ok = True
all_digits = []

    all_digits.append(m % w)
    m //= w

i = 0
while i < len(all_digits):
    digit = all_digits[i]
    if digit == 0 or digit == 1:
        i += 1
        continue
    if digit == w - 1:
        j = i + 1
        while j < len(all_digits):
            if all_digits[j] == w - 1:
                all_digits[j] = 0
            else:
                all_digits[j] += 1
                break
            j += 1
        i += 1
        continue
    else:
        ok = False
        break
    i += 1

if ok:
    print("YES")
else:
    print("NO")
